title: Before you start
tagline: What Git is, the five core words, how teams work, hosting sites, CI/CD, the terminal
description: No typing yet. Six short reads that explain what Git is for, the words everyone uses, how real teams work every day, and how this platform works, so the labs make sense from the first command.

title: Foundations
tagline: Your first repository, commits, choosing what to save, reading history, keeping junk out
description: A small personal project, one idea at a time: create a repository, make commits, choose what each commit contains, read history, and keep secrets and generated files out.

title: Branching & Merging
tagline: Branches, merge shapes, conflicts, switching context safely
description: Work on a task without touching main, bring the work back together, resolve a conflict without losing anyone's intent, and park unfinished work when priorities change.

title: Remotes & Collaboration
tagline: Clone, fetch, push, forks, pull requests, code review
description: Share work through a hosted platform: integrate remote changes, recover from rejected pushes, contribute through forks and run a pull request end to end.

title: Rewriting History
tagline: Amend, interactive rebase, rebase vs merge, cherry-pick
description: Shape a branch into reviewable commits before opening a pull request, and learn the one rule that keeps rewriting safe.

title: Recovery & Incident Response
tagline: Reflog, revert, bisect, detached HEAD, leaked secrets
description: Nothing committed is lost. Find it, undo it safely in production, and track down the commit that broke things.

title: Team Workflows at Scale
tagline: Trunk-based, GitFlow, hotfixes, releases, protection rules
description: Run the workflows real teams use: hotfix while main has unreleased work, cut releases, and work under branch protection and code owners.

title: Capstones
tagline: Sprint week, incident night, open source contributor
description: Multi-step, timed scenarios with bot teammates and minimal hints, pulling every track together.
